title: The plan checker rule R22 fails a plan that keeps a list row's text card while dropping its picture (or the reverse) when the template kit records paired slots per row, and skips when the kit has none
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-timeout=60000 apps/tracy-web/test/site-plan-check-row-pairs.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail and skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.
The rule is R22 in apps/tracy-web/src/site-planner/plan-check/rules-row-pairs.js and CHECKER_VERSION is site-plan-check/4.
evidence: 05/11/2026: sealed plan e3635ab9 for JA Boxing dropped the pictures of class-page rows 2 to 4 (lists article-2/14/15/16.video) while keeping their text, and site-plan-check/3 passed it 27/27.
fence: The rule on fabricated kits and plans only. Not exercised: a live planner run.
